## Projects and technologies

### Key Projects
- **Zenius AI**: Real-time e-learning platform built at MSRDCENTER featuring WebRTC live video classrooms, Socket.IO chat, Gemini AI quiz generator from course documents, and role-based access control.
- **CaptionFlow**: Multilingual AI video captioning platform featuring Groq Whisper and Sarvam AI transcription, LCS word-level timestamp alignment, and FFmpeg subtitle rendering.
- **LinkGuard**: High-speed URL shortener built with Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, and Redis caching under 100ms redirect response time with JWT authentication and QR codes.
- **Loopora**: AI interview preparation platform offering 500+ technical questions with written answers, video explanations, and Gemini API personalization.

### Core Technologies
- **Languages & Frontend**: JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend & Real-Time**: Node.js, Express.js, Spring Boot, WebRTC, Socket.IO
- **Databases & Caching**: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis
- **Tools & Media**: Git, GitHub, Docker, FFmpeg, Gemini API, Groq API
